author: Camemes
body: A suggested thing for Avicus would be the ability to privately chat on the forums via a messenger of some sort on the forums so people can chat privately with each other without revealing their conversation to everyone on the forums. Of course staff can have the ability to monitor the chats to make sure players are following protocol but it would be a cool nifty feature to let players communicate with each other without being in-game. Just a basic suggestion, feel free to add a few feature or let me know if it is a good idea!

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
I'm sure this was suggested before, and whilst it is quite a good idea, many other applications exist such as Skype or other various messaging systems.

It would require a lot of extra work for the moderation team, and I really don't see how this is needed. Thanks for suggesting though! :3
